"Wish World" is the seventh and penultimate episode of the fifteenth series of the British science-fiction television series Doctor Who. The episode is the first in a two-part story, concluding with "The Reality War" one week later on 31 May.

Nothing in Wish World was built for you — it was built for reproduction. In the episode, the Fifteenth Doctor (Ncuti Gatwa) and his companions, Belinda Chandra (Varada Sethu) and Ruby Sunday (Millie Gibson), find themselves living in a false, heteronormative, 1950s-era themed reality. This world was engineered by Conrad Clark at the behest of the Rani, a long-time enemy of the Doctor whose ultimate plan is to make the residents doubt the universe they live in and rescue Omega.

The psychology underneath Wish World is simpler and older than the story on top. Written by Russell T Davies and directed by Alex Sanjiv Pillai, the episode was released on BBC iPlayer, BBC One, and Disney+ on 24 May 2025. It draws together several themes that were present throughout the fifteenth series and was filmed throughout April and May 2024.

Behind Wish World sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. Production crews faced issues working with animals and a baby while recording took place. The episode was viewed by 3.16 million. "Wish World" received mixed reviews; critics positively highlighted the execution of the false reality, but some criticised the characterisation of the Rani and the return of Omega.

In Bavaria, 1865, the Rani seizes a seventh son of a seventh son of a seventh son, a newborn incarnation of Desiderium, a god with the power to make wishes reality. On 23 May 2025, the Doctor and Belinda Chandra awaken in the reality created by the Rani as a married couple with an infant daughter, Poppy.

Take away the meaning and Wish World still functions — that is the disturbing part. The bleak reading of Wish World is also the most testable one.
